result.instructions: Tools for Timebutler, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Who is on holiday next week, and who still needs to approve a request?"; "How many vacation days do I have left this year?"; "Start my time clock on project Website, category Development.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Timebutler data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run timebutler_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run timebutler_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run timebutler_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. timebutler_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: timebutler_get_profile
tools.title: Get my profile
tools.description: Get the profile of the user behind the token: id, name, email, role (USER, MANAGER or ADMIN), department, branch office, and whether business trips and time tracking are enabled. Timebutler API: GET /user/profile.

tools.name: timebutler_list_employees
tools.title: List employees
tools.description: List the employees the caller can see (manager or admin only), with ids, names, role, department, manager ids and active flag. Use the ids in other tools. Timebutler API: GET /employees.

tools.name: timebutler_list_absence_types
tools.title: List absence types
tools.description: List the absence types the company configured (vacation, sickness and others), with whether each needs approval, a medical certificate, or allows half days. Use the id in timebutler_create_absence_request. Timebutler API: GET /absence-types.

tools.name: timebutler_list_categories
tools.title: List time categories
tools.description: List the time-tracking categories and the default category id. Use an id in the clock and time-entry tools. Timebutler API: GET /categories.

tools.name: timebutler_list_projects
tools.title: List projects
tools.description: List the time-tracking projects, the default project id, and whether a project is mandatory. Use an id in the clock and time-entry tools. Timebutler API: GET /projects.

tools.name: timebutler_list_my_absence_requests
tools.title: List my absence requests
tools.description: List the caller's own absence requests with dates, days or hours, half-day setting, and status (pending, approved or rejected). Timebutler API: GET /absence-requests/my.

tools.name: timebutler_list_team_absence_requests
tools.title: List team absence requests
tools.description: List absence requests of the employees the caller manages (manager or admin only). Shows status and employee names. Timebutler API: GET /absence-requests/team.

tools.name: timebutler_get_absence_pending_count
tools.title: Count pending absence requests
tools.description: Count the open absence requests and open cancellation requests for the caller's team (manager or admin only). Timebutler API: GET /absence-requests/pending-count.

tools.name: timebutler_list_my_time_entries
tools.title: List my time entries
tools.description: List the caller's recorded time entries, sorted by date and start time. Without year and month it returns the current month; year alone returns a whole year. Optional filters: project, category and status. Timebutler API: GET /time-entries/my.

projectId.description: Only entries of this project id.

categoryId.description: Only entries of this category id.

status.description: Only entries with this status, for example pending or approved.

tools.name: timebutler_get_time_entry_pending_count
tools.title: Count pending time entries
tools.description: Count the time entries of the caller's team that wait for approval (manager or admin only). Timebutler API: GET /time-entries/pending-count.

tools.name: timebutler_list_time_entry_requests
tools.title: List time entry requests
tools.description: List the pending time entry requests of the caller's team with date, start and end time, worked minutes, project and remarks (manager or admin only). Timebutler API: GET /time-entry-requests.

tools.name: timebutler_get_time_clock_status
tools.title: Get time clock status
tools.description: Get the caller's time clock state: idle, running, paused or waiting, with the start time, elapsed work seconds and break seconds. Timebutler API: GET /time-clock/status.

tools.name: timebutler_get_work_summary
tools.title: Get today's work summary
tools.description: Get today's working-time summary for the caller: commitment, worked, remaining minutes, percent done and break minutes. Timebutler API: GET /time-tracking/work-summary.

tools.name: timebutler_get_time_off_summary
tools.title: Get time-off summary
tools.description: Get the caller's vacation and sickness balance: vacation days total, remaining, approved and pending, and illness days taken. Timebutler API: GET /time-tracking/time-off-summary.

tools.name: timebutler_clock_start
tools.title: Start time clock
tools.description: Start the caller's time clock. Fails with HTTP 409 when the clock already runs. The clock can enter the waiting state first if the company sets a minimum start interval. Timebutler API: POST /time-clock/start.

tools.name: timebutler_clock_pause
tools.title: Pause time clock
tools.description: Pause the running time clock of the caller (starts a break). Timebutler API: POST /time-clock/pause.

tools.name: timebutler_clock_resume
tools.title: Resume time clock
tools.description: Resume the paused time clock of the caller (ends the break). Timebutler API: POST /time-clock/resume.

tools.name: timebutler_clock_stop
tools.title: Stop time clock and save
tools.description: Stop the running or paused time clock and save the resulting time entry. Optional project id, category id and remarks. A waiting clock is discarded (HTTP 204). Timebutler API: POST /time-clock/stop.

breakRegulation.description: Apply or ignore the company break rule.

tools.name: timebutler_submit_clock_entry
tools.title: Submit a finished time entry
tools.description: Create a finished time entry from a start and end time on the same calendar day. Timestamps are Unix milliseconds. If the company needs manager approval, the entry starts as pending. Timebutler API: POST /time-tracking/clock-entry.

startTimestamp.description: Work start, Unix time in milliseconds.

endTimestamp.description: Work end, Unix time in milliseconds. Same day as the start.

pauseSeconds.description: Total break time inside the work period, in seconds.

projectId.description: Project id. 0 or omit when no project applies.

categoryId.description: Category id. 0 or omit when no category applies.

tools.name: timebutler_create_absence_request
tools.title: Request absence
tools.description: Submit an absence or vacation request for the caller. The status is pending when the absence type needs manager approval, otherwise approved. Timebutler API: POST /absence-requests.

halfDay.description: Half-day request for a single day.

hours.description: Hours, as text, for an hourly absence type.

substituteEmployeeId.description: Employee id of the substitute, from timebutler_list_employees.

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with Timebutler
prompts.description: What you can do with Timebutler here, with example requests to try.
